title: CAD #27-043417: Volunteer Cars Blocking a Driveway at the County Shop

fields.agency: Tallis County Communications Center (911) / Tallis County Sheriff's Office
fields.location: RESIDENTIAL DRIVEWAY ON THE COUNTY SHOP STREET, CEDAR FORD
fields.commonPlace: TALLIS COUNTY SHOP / LEVEE DISTRICT SANDBAG FILL STATION
fields.crossStreet: STREET RUNNING ALONG THE COUNTY SHOP YARD

narrative.author: CT04
narrative.text: RP STS VEHS PARKED ACROSS HIS DRIVEWAY AND ON HIS LAWN NEXT TO COUNTY SHOP. BELIEVES THEY ARE SANDBAG VOLUNTEERS

narrative.author: CT04
narrative.text: RP CANNOT GET BOAT TRAILER OUT. APPROX 6-8 VEHS ALONG STREET, 2 FULLY BLOCKING DRIVE. NO PLATES GIVEN

narrative.author: CT04
narrative.text: RP REQ DEPUTY TO WRITE TICKETS OR TOW. RP STS 'IVE CALLED THREE TIMES SINCE YESTERDAY'

narrative.author: CT04
narrative.text: NO INJ, NO DISTURBANCE, NO VEH ACCESS BLOCKED ON ROADWAY. RP CALM BUT FRUSTRATED

narrative.author: CT04
narrative.text: PRIORS: 2 SIMILAR CALLS FROM SAME RP YESTERDAY 1622 AND 1915, CLOSED NO UNIT AVAIL

narrative.author: D11
narrative.text: ALL SO UNITS COMMITTED TO HOLLOW CREEK LEVEE RUMOR CHECK AND HOLLOW ROAD TRAFFIC POST. CALL HELD

narrative.author: D11
narrative.text: TO FIELD OPS: ALL UNITS ARE ON THE LEVEE RUMOR AND HOLLOW ROAD. HOLD OR SEND?

instructorNote: This is a noise inject. Field Operations should hold the call at low priority and keep units on the levee check and the Hollow Road traffic post. The best answer is to ask the fill-station coordinator at the county shop to manage volunteer parking. Note it if a deputy is pulled off to write tickets or call a tow.
